'''Umbara''', informally known as the '''Shadow World''' due to the rays of its [[Star/Legends|sun]] never completely reaching its surface, was a perpetually dark [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the reaches of the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]]. It was home to the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of pale [[Near-Human]]s. It was also the site of a large [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Hovertrain_on_Umbara.jpg|thumb|200px|left|A hovertrain crashes on Umbara after sabotage.]]
Umbara was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from that government's earliest days.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> After the fall of the [[Eternal Empire|Empire of]] [[Zakuul]], and the rise of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3629 BBY]], Umbara was the site of a [[Crisis on Umbara|crisis]] originating in the [[War on Iokath|renewed war]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Working with the Alliance's enemies, [[Theron Shan]], in league with the Umbarans, attempted to steal a stockpile of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] on route to the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]], though were ultimately foiled by [[Lana Beniko]] and the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the Alliance.<ref name="TOR" />

The founder of the [[New Sith]] Empire, [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]], was an Umbaran and his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was under Sith control by [[1002 BBY]], when the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] operated a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|academy]] on the world that specialized in the training of [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] known as the [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin]]s. These assassins used the Force to mask their presence from others, this worked even against [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]. The primary weapon of these assassins was the [[Force pike/Legends|Force pike]].<ref name="POD" />

[[File:Umbarans-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Umbarans battle forces of the Grand Army of the Republic on their homeworld.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="Encyclopedia: Umbara" /> and fellow Umbaran [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]] worked as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]].<ref name="Sly" /> Later in the war, Umbara joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] following the assassination of Deechi and the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led an [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invasion]] to retake the planet.<ref name="DoU" />

Since many Umbarans served as spies for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] most of them retreated back to Umbara, fearing retribution.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> The planet remained isolated even after the [[Swarm War]], though many predicted the Umbarans would eventually seek to establish a presence in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]].
